decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Amulet of Vigor combo pieces to generate massive amounts of mana and consistently put Primeval Titan onto the battlefield. Cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Summoner's Pact help find and tutor for key pieces, while lands like Simic Growth Chamber and Gruul Turf allow for multiple land drops in a turn. The goal is to ramp up quickly and take advantage of Primeval Titan's ability to search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to deal massive damage to the opponent in a short amount of time.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Eldrazi Temple and Green Sun's Zenith to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog, Emrakul, and Drowner of Truth. Control the board with cards like Slumbering Trudge, Ugin's Labyrinth, and Kozilek's Command while also generating extra mana with Disciple of Freyalise and Gemstone Caverns. Utilize Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn to disrupt opponents and finish with massive Eldrazi beaters. The deck focuses on overwhelming opponents with huge threats and disrupting their game plan, establishing dominance and control over the battlefield.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through various means such as hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, efficient counter spells like Counterspell and Spell Snare, and removal like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also features powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been exhausted. The mana base is designed to support the deck's game plan while also providing flexibility and consistency in casting its spells.

The main idea of this Aggro - Hollow One deck is to quickly flood the board with powerful creatures like Hollow One and Vengevine by using cards that allow for fast and efficient card draw and mana ramp. By utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Faithless Looting, the deck aims to quickly discard cards and bring out big threats early in the game. With a mix of powerful creatures and burn spells like Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on control through land destruction and removal spells. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and board presence while using cards like Avenger's Disassembled and Price of Freedom to maintain control of the game. With a mix of removal spells, land destruction, and powerful finishers like Wrath of the Skies and Solitude, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent until victory. The inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion adds an additional creature option for increased flexibility and synergy within the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Devourer of Destiny and Thud or Plunge into Darkness to deal massive amounts of damage to your opponent. By using cards like Serum Powder and Spoils of the Vault to dig through your deck, you can set up the combo quickly and efficiently. Inquisition of Kozilek helps disrupt your opponent's game plan, while cards like Aloe Alchemist and Callous Sell-Sword provide support for your combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Lotus Bloom, Whir of Invention, and Goblin Charbelcher to quickly win the game without relying on lands. It includes counterspells and disruption spells to protect the combo and control the opponent's board. The deck also utilizes card draw and filtering effects like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Sea Gate Restoration to find the necessary pieces for the combo. Overall, the goal is to efficiently set up the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a game-winning play.

The deck is focused on utilizing the Song of Creation enchantment card to generate card advantage and speed up the player's combo potential. It includes various cards that can help set up the combo, manipulate the board state, and protect against disruption from opponents. The deck features a mix of mana accelerants, card draw spells, and powerful combo pieces like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

This deck relies on using Allosaurus Rider alongside Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to quickly generate a powerful board presence. Planar Genesis can help ramp up mana and flood the board with creatures. Generous Ent provides additional utility and support for the combo strategy. Consign to Memory can be used to protect key pieces and disrupt opponents. Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and Xenagos, God of Revels offer additional finishers to close out the game. Pact of Negation provides protection while other cards like Veil of Summer and Nature's Claim offer additional utility and disruption options.

The main concept of this combo landless deck is to use Hydroelectric Specimen and Tameshi, Reality Architect to generate mana and eventually cast Goblin Charbelcher for a game-winning combo. The deck focuses on card advantage and countering opponents' spells to protect the combo pieces. It utilizes alternate win conditions like Stock Up and Lotus Bloom for additional flexibility. The deck also includes disruptors like Disrupting Shoal and Sink into Stupor to control the board and slow down aggressive opponents. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces and take the opponent by surprise with a powerful Charbelcher finisher.

This deck revolves around quickly tutoring and sacrificing creatures to cheat out powerful threats like Griselbrand and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant. It uses Eldritch Evolution, Neoform, and Summoner's Pact to search for key creatures, while also employing Nourishing Shoal and Hedge Maze to gain life and protection. The combination of Allosaurus Rider and Xenagos, God of Revels allows for explosive turns, and cards like Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer provide protection and disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and combo plays.

The deck focuses on leveraging artifact synergies and graveyard recursion to assemble powerful combos, disrupting opponents with control elements like counterspells and disruption effects. It aims to generate advantage through card draw and mana acceleration, using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to power out threats and combo pieces quickly. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and recursion, while Urza's Saga helps tutor for important artifacts. The deck's win conditions include utilizing Grinding Station and Cori-Steel Cutter to mill the opponent out or assemble a lethal combo.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly through cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Eldrazi Temple in order to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. Control elements are incorporated through cards like Kozilek's Command and Ugin, Eye of the Storms to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Disciple of Freyalise and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional ramp and mana fixing, while Malevolent Rumble offers board control. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its big, hard-hitting creatures while controlling the board and mana advantage.

This deck focuses on reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand quickly with cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Superior Spider-Man. It also utilizes cards like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protection spells like Ephemerate and Force of Negation to keep the combo pieces safe. Using Atraxa, Grand Unifier to benefit from casting multiple colors of spells and tools like Psychic Frog for card advantage, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with unique abilities to create powerful combos and generate value. It includes cards that can search for specific creatures, generate mana, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and provide various forms of recursion and card advantage. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by assembling powerful synergies between its creatures and combo pieces, while also disrupting their strategy with removal and disruptive spells. It can quickly adapt to different situations and generate overwhelming board presence with its toolbox of creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing removal spells like Path to Exile and Solitude, while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Field of Ruin and Cleansing Wildfire. The deck also aims to protect its own resources with cards like Rest in Peace and Wrath of the Skies. Additionally, the deck can generate advantage through cards like Price of Freedom and Demolition Field. Overall, this Boros Ponza Control deck seeks to dominate the battlefield and outvalue the opponent.
